# MUST_REDACT — every line must have its secret removed by the redactor.
#
# EVERY VALUE HERE IS FAKE, and no literal credential is stored in this file.
# The random-looking parts are written as placeholders and expanded by the test
# loader, so the committed bytes contain no secret-shaped string at all.
#
# That is not decoration. The first version of this file used literal fake
# tokens, and GitHub push protection rejected the push: its GitLab and Slack
# detectors matched. Templating keeps the fixtures structurally realistic
# enough to exercise the patterns honestly while leaving nothing in git history
# that a scanner -- or a human skimming the diff -- has to evaluate. Never
# paste a real key here: this file is committed, and a committed secret is a
# leaked secret.
#
# Placeholders, expanded by tests/test_redaction_corpus.py:
#   {fN}  N characters of mixed-case letters and digits
#   {uN}  N characters of uppercase letters and digits
#   {lN}  N characters of lowercase letters and digits
#
# Lines beginning with # are comments. Blank lines are ignored.
# Format: <secret><TAB><the full line it appears in>
